episode.title: perf(core): chat history O(n^2) re-serialization on every turn causes jank on long sessions
episode.before: The pinned commit's parent was af687798afe3b83fd8bf46e91d659c88347427ba. In the parent implementation, the interactive tool coordinator appended combined cancellation function responses to the durable chat history even when all model-initiated tools in the turn were cancelled. The interactive and legacy execution paths could also finish after a tool continuation that produced no visible response. For invalid-stream retries, GeminiChat appended retry nudges to the system instruction rather than to the end of the current request contents. The edit self-correction path did not reject a blank search string before invoking the correction helper, and no-match feedback was less specific.
episode.after: The interactive coordinator records a history-length checkpoint before sending a prepared query and truncates the current history back to that checkpoint when all model-initiated tools are cancelled, without appending cancellation responses or issuing another model request. Interactive continuations now detect empty post-tool output and submit a recovery nudge with a per-user-query budget of two automatic attempts. The legacy execution loop performs the corresponding post-tool empty-response recovery once per armed tool-response cycle. GeminiChat now keeps systemInstruction stable and applies invalid-stream retry nudges to request contents, preserving role alternation and reapplying the nudge after hook content replacement. The edit invocation rejects missing or whitespace-only old_string before LLM correction and returns more actionable exact-match guidance. The commit also adds outgoing empty-part normalization and a wording-only attribution cleanup.
episode.diff: Commit 812f7a2bcf20b6e80e2e50c3c8fa8e26567bc1e8 changes nine files: interactive stream coordination and tests, legacy agent/session behavior and tests, GeminiChat retry/content handling and tests, and Edit-tool validation and tests. The semantic changes are bounded cancellation-history rollback, bounded recovery after silent tool continuations, end-of-context retry nudging, payload-part normalization, and early edit-input rejection. The available evidence contains regression tests for the primary rollback, recovery, retry-placement, and edit-guard paths, but no performance benchmark proving the reported O(n^2) symptom or a dedicated test for the new empty-part sanitizer.

candidate_atomics.name: rollback-cancelled-tool-turn
candidate_atomics.description: When every model-initiated tool in an interactive turn is cancelled, restore the conversation to the checkpoint taken before the current query instead of recording cancellation responses as a new user turn or sending another request.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent cancelled in-flight tool turns from persisting as transcript state and avoid unnecessary follow-up work.
semantic_action.pre_state: A prepared query has been sent, the model has appended a tool-call turn, all applicable model-initiated tools are terminally cancelled, and current history is longer than the saved query checkpoint.
semantic_action.post_state: History is truncated to the saved checkpoint; cancellation response parts are not appended and no continuation request is emitted.
semantic_action.validation: Interactive stream regression tests verify that addHistory is not called, history returns to the pre-model length, and the model stream is not called again for one or multiple cancelled tools.

candidate_atomics.name: bounded-interactive-post-tool-nudge
candidate_atomics.description: Recover an interactive continuation that follows tool execution but ends without visible text by issuing a bounded recovery nudge through the normal continuation path.

semantic_action.intent: Remove silent post-tool turns while bounding automatic recovery work.
semantic_action.pre_state: A continuation after tool execution finishes with no tool calls and no non-whitespace visible text; the current user query has fewer than two automatic nudge attempts.
semantic_action.post_state: A continuation request carrying the recovery nudge is submitted and the per-user-query counter is incremented; no automatic nudge is submitted after the two-attempt budget is exhausted.
semantic_action.validation: The interactive-hook test observes a second send containing the exact recovery nudge after an empty continuation.

candidate_atomics.name: bounded-session-post-tool-nudge
candidate_atomics.description: In the session execution loop, recover from an empty response immediately following completed tool calls by sending a dedicated nudge before allowing normal completion.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent a tool-execution path from terminating without a user-facing explanation when the first post-tool response is empty.
semantic_action.pre_state: At least one tool call has completed, the next stream has no tool calls, and it emits no non-whitespace content.
semantic_action.post_state: The loop sends the recovery nudge as the next request, clears the armed-after-tool state, and continues; a visible response can then complete the session.
semantic_action.validation: The legacy-session test asserts three stream calls, the exact nudge payload on the third call, tool request/response events, and the final agent message; the non-interactive regression test confirms the additional recovery call.

candidate_atomics.name: end-of-context-retry-nudge
candidate_atomics.description: Place invalid-stream retry guidance at the end of request contents while preserving API role ordering and hook modifications, instead of mutating the stable system instruction.

semantic_action.intent: Make retry guidance visible at the current context boundary without invalidating or expanding the stable system-instruction prefix.
semantic_action.pre_state: A retry follows a thought-only or no-response-text invalid stream; request contents may end in a model turn, an ordinary user turn, or a function-response user turn, and hooks may replace contents.
semantic_action.post_state: System instruction is unchanged; the retry nudge is present at the end of valid contents, role alternation is preserved with a synthetic model bridge when required, and an existing final-turn nudge is not duplicated.
semantic_action.validation: GeminiChat tests assert unchanged systemInstruction, nudge placement in contents, reapplication after hook-modified contents, handling of empty/model/function-response histories, and deduplication.

candidate_atomics.name: sanitize-empty-payload-parts
candidate_atomics.description: Normalize outgoing content parts so an empty text field cannot invalidate a payload-bearing part or remain as a truly empty text-only part.

semantic_action.intent: Keep active tool, code, file, or similar payloads usable while removing empty text artifacts that can trigger request validation failures.
semantic_action.pre_state: An outgoing part has text equal to the empty string, either alongside another active payload or as its only meaningful field.
semantic_action.post_state: The empty text key is removed from payload-bearing parts; text-only empty parts are filtered; other payload-bearing parts remain.
semantic_action.validation: The implementation contains separate payload-preservation and empty-part filtering branches, but no dedicated regression assertion for this newly added sanitizer behavior is present in the pinned commit tests.

candidate_atomics.name: reject-blank-edit-search
candidate_atomics.description: Reject a blank or whitespace-only edit search string before the expensive LLM correction path is invoked and return a localized instruction to reread the target before retrying.

semantic_action.intent: Avoid spending correction-model work on an invalid edit request and make the repair precondition explicit.
semantic_action.pre_state: An edit invocation reaches self-correction with old_string missing or containing only whitespace.
semantic_action.post_state: Execution returns an INVALID_TOOL_PARAMS error without invoking the LLM edit fixer and tells the agent to inspect the target with ReadFile before supplying an exact search string.
semantic_action.validation: The edit test uses whitespace-only old_string and asserts that the fixer is not called, the error type is INVALID_TOOL_PARAMS, and the returned message includes ReadFile guidance.

candidate_atomics.name: clarify-edit-no-match-guidance
candidate_atomics.description: Replace vague no-occurrence edit feedback with exact-match guidance that points the agent to current file content before retrying.

semantic_action.intent: Make a failed localized edit actionable by distinguishing an exact-match miss and directing the agent to inspect current content.
semantic_action.pre_state: A nonblank edit search string produces zero matches in the current file.
semantic_action.post_state: The tool reports an exact-match failure and advises rereading the target/current lines before retrying; the correction path remains available for valid nonblank input according to its existing policy.
semantic_action.validation: The edit regression test checks that both LLM-facing content and display output contain the new exact-match wording.

candidate_workflows.name: interactive-tool-turn-bounding
candidate_workflows.description: The interactive path has two event-dependent recovery branches: remove a cancelled tool turn from durable history, or recover a silent successful tool continuation with a bounded nudge.

workflow_graph.goal: Keep interactive tool turns bounded and recoverable without growing invalid or silent conversation state.
workflow_graph.entry_state: A user query is being processed; the model may request tools, produce an empty continuation, or have all requested tools cancelled.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Cancelled turns are absent from durable history, or a post-tool continuation produces visible completion or stops after the automatic-nudge budget.
unresolved_or_deferred: The two actions are predicate-selected branches of the same coordinator rather than a mandatory sequence: rollback applies to all-cancelled tool turns, while nudging applies to a successful tool continuation with no visible response. The tests do not establish a cross-branch ordering.

candidate_workflows.name: session-tool-continuation-recovery
candidate_workflows.description: The session loop arms recovery after completed tools, checks the next response for visible content, and nudges once before allowing normal completion.

workflow_graph.goal: Ensure a tool execution is followed by an explanatory model response even when the first continuation is empty.
workflow_graph.entry_state: The session has completed one or more model-initiated tool calls and is about to process the next model stream.
workflow_graph.exit_state: The model emits visible text after the recovery request or the session follows its normal completion/failure path.
unresolved_or_deferred: The implementation arms one recovery nudge per completed-tool cycle but does not expose a numeric retry budget; repeated empty output after the nudge follows the normal completion path.

candidate_workflows.name: model-retry-request-integrity
candidate_workflows.description: The model request path adapts invalid-stream retry guidance to the current contents and then normalizes outgoing parts before the API call.

workflow_graph.goal: Bound retry guidance and preserve valid request-content contracts at the model boundary.
workflow_graph.entry_state: A retry request contains an invalid-stream condition or outgoing parts with empty text artifacts.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Retry guidance is appended to valid request contents, the stable system instruction is preserved, and payload-bearing parts are not rejected solely because of an empty text key.
unresolved_or_deferred: The sanitizer is in the final request-construction path, but the pinned commit adds no direct regression assertion for its new empty-part branches. The edge captures request construction order, not a requirement that every retry contain an empty part.

candidate_workflows.name: edit-request-budget-guard
candidate_workflows.description: The edit path handles two predicate-dependent failures: reject blank selectors before correction-model work, or return exact-match guidance for nonblank selectors that do not match current content.

workflow_graph.goal: Prevent invalid localized edits from consuming correction work and provide actionable repair guidance for stale or mismatched input.
workflow_graph.entry_state: An edit invocation supplies either a blank search string or a nonblank string with zero matches.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Blank input fails before LLM correction, or a no-match error tells the agent to reread current target lines and retry with an exact match.
unresolved_or_deferred: The two edit actions are mutually exclusive predicate branches for a given invocation. The wording-only confirmation-attribution change is recorded as evidence but is not promoted to a separate semantic action.

unresolved_questions: The issue bundle has no issue body, comments, timeline, author/review discussion, or linked pull-request metadata; the local commit and tests are the available resolution evidence.

The pinned commit subject references pull request #28934 while the bundle anchors issue 29080; the checkout establishes an implementation-bearing change but does not establish a direct issue-to-PR discussion link.

The commit groups several behavior clusters—history rollback, post-tool recovery, retry-content nudging, empty-part sanitation, and edit-tool validation. Available metadata does not prove whether the sanitizer, edit changes, and wording cleanup were all in the issue's intended scope.

The empty-part sanitizer has implementation evidence but no dedicated test oracle in the pinned commit. The wording-only confirmation-attribution change likewise has no dedicated new test and is not represented as a candidate atomic.
No target tests were executed because the checkout has no installed node_modules; validation claims are based on the added and updated test assertions inspected at the pinned ref.

No performance benchmark or runtime trace is present, so the extraction records the concrete history/retry/resource-control mechanisms and their regression oracles without claiming that the O(n^2) latency symptom was measured or fully eliminated.

The supplied universal class bounded-resource-budget-control is retained as a routing hypothesis. The observed mechanisms support that hypothesis through bounded cancellation-history state, bounded automatic recovery, stable-prefix-preserving retry guidance, and early rejection of invalid edit work, but issue discussion is unavailable to confirm the classification.
